purpose: Govern inbound and outbound settlement facts, provider transaction identity, value dates, terminal evidence, and bounded reversals.
authority_rules: External rails require a successful matching attempt before settlement.
Cash and internal credit may settle without provider-attempt authority.
Operational accounts must be active tenant-scoped leaf accounts in the same currency and organization.
Confirmed external settlements require immutable provider transaction identity and evidence.
Failed settlement evidence remains queryable and is never rewritten.
Reversals are compensating facts and cannot exceed the original gross amount.
Command replays return the original result; changed payloads conflict.
M4.3 creates no value source, allocation, financial event, journal, or outbox record.
